chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who forgot the qunūt in the obligatory prayer. He said: There is no repetition required upon him.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, the one being asked for the ruling
key_terms.الْقُنُوتَ: the qunūt supplication performed in prayer
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the case in question

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets the qunūt in an obligatory prayer, must the prayer be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person forgets the qunūt in an obligatory prayer, the prayer does not need to be repeated. It indicates a legal ruling concerning an omitted recommended act within salat.
